item.title: Video: Octopath Traveler I & II Side-By-Side Graphics Comparison (Switch 1 & 2)

description.p: Spot the difference.Following a surprise announcement in July, Square Enix has officially released Octopath Traveler and Octopath Traveler 2 on the Switch 2 this week. If you are wondering how the HD-2D RPG series looks on Nintendo's new hybrid system compared to the old one, side-by-side graphics comparison videos are now being uploaded online.According to Square Enix, the Switch 2 versions come with "improved resolution and framerate". RPG Site has taken a closer look, and the Switch 2 versions of these titles run at 60fps, while the original Switch versions target 30fps.
